state.paragraph: On June 21, 2013, Party A submitted an unsolicited proposal to the Mac-Gray Board of Directors offering to purchase Mac-Gray for an all-cash purchase price of $17.00 to $19.00 per share, which we refer to as the Party A June 21 proposal.

ledger_rows.Note: Re-engaged as the target's sole financial adviser for the strategic review and possible sale, chosen from three banks. Engagement letter 05/31; no buyer financing without consent.
Moab (about 9% holder) won a proxy contest; Rothenberg and Hyman replaced incumbents. The filing does not say Moab pressed for a sale. Rothenberg was later excluded over Moab's rollover interest.
Unsolicited proposal to the board, made before any NDA or diligence (Heavy by context). It was still standing when round 1 was evaluated on 07/25.
Board forms a Special Committee of six independent directors, excluding CEO MacDonald and Moab's Rothenberg. The committee will weigh a sale against staying stand-alone and approach 50 parties.

ledger_rows.When: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013
ledger_rows.Note: Target outreach. Of 50 contacted (15 strategic, 35 financial), Party A (#2) and CSC/Pamplona (#10) are recorded separately, leaving 13 strategic parties.

ledger_rows.When: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013
ledger_rows.Note: Target outreach to all 35 financial parties (including private equity), among them Party B and Party C. 50 contacted in total.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
